collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VI (101-120, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A yawn goes all the way round the fire at dinner, and a villager wants to know why yawns are catching.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At dinner, (subject) yawns. Across the fire, (friend) yawns. Then someone else does, and then a child, and then, (subject) is almost sure, a dog lying by the fire. (subject) sits up. "Did you see that? It went all the way round."

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) yawns a huge, deliberate yawn. (friend) yawns. (subject) does it again. Two more people yawn. Soon the entire fire is yawning, and nobody can stop, and (subject) is yawning so much (subject.he/she) can't explain the experiment. Everybody goes to bed very early. Nobody is sure if that was science or not.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Why would a yawn jump from person to person? Is it because they're all tired? Is it because people like doing what their friends do? (subject) is still wondering when (subject.he/she) catches (subject.him/her)self yawning, just from thinking about yawns. (subject.He/She) gives up and goes to bed.
